title: Consider naming the remote gate's passed result in the evidence the integration owner records under "Test refs for remote runs"
outcome: The coordinators decide, and if they amend it they do so under the authority-text procedure (a)-(c) with Greg's word, whether the list of what the integration owner records for a remote full gate (run id, host, commit, tree id, before and after fingerprints) should also name the run's passed result and per-stage counts, so that the item's lasting record shows the gate was green.
acceptance: Consider naming the remote gate's passed result in the evidence the integration owner records under "Test refs for remote runs" is done
